name: Mullvad Orb
author: vonsensey
description: Mullvad VPN on a spinning globe. Pick a server by clicking a dot or searching country, city and server; the orb flies there and draws your tunnel. Every Mullvad setting included: multihop, DAITA, quantum-resistant tunnels, lockdown, DNS content blockers, anti-censorship, custom lists, split tunneling, API access, devices and account. Themed from your Omarchy colors. Unofficial; not affiliated with Mullvad VPN AB.

barWidget.description: Tunnel state as a lock. Click opens the globe, right click connects or disconnects, middle click switches to a new server.
